about_the_game:
Not being one cut out for farm work, instead you help out at the church doing any handiwork Sophie couldn't handle herself. One day while cleaning out one of the backrooms you serendipitously stumble upon a mysterious grimoire chock full of unholy hypnosis spells, who could have left that there?! Nearing the end of your masculine endurance, desperate to lay a hand on the succulent bod of Sister Sophie its time to don your wizard hat and cast some spells!

Two paths lay before you. Do you totally wipe out the saintly side of Sophie and dick into the only object of devotion, making her your #1 cock worshipper? OR, do you enjoy the best of both worlds and have her act as Sister Sophie in the streets and become an unholy whore in the sheets! 

FEATURES

• Faithful recreation of the original Japanese Visual Novel

• Sister Sophie is fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue

• Original artwork HD upscaled with 16:9 and 4:3 variants

• Click though and read hours of story content

• Audio including music and special effects

• Enhanced with animated character sprites

• A CG Gallery and Scene selections

• Over a dozen hypnotic H-Scenes to twist the mind of poor Sister Sophie

Sister Sophie's Creed to Breed is the English localization of a Visual Novel originally created by prolific Japanese developer Miel. We at Cherry Kiss aim to provide an authentic Japanese Visual Novel experience to gamers outside of Japan.

**PLEASE NOTE**

All characters described and visually represented in this game are over 18 years of age, and no actual, nor identifiable minor was used in the production of this game.
